note: Voice Notes DEV set (Windows). 27 spoken questions covering the topics the lead found weak on 2026-11-08 (README section 9): water height, flood cut, drywall amount and cost, mold, per-room, laptop/router, the fridge note, 'what did I miss?', plus coverage/cost/hazard/status controls. Used to build the templates, so it is a development set, not a held-out number. Each 'expect' entry is a list of alternatives; every entry must match (case-insensitive substring). 'seen' simulates gaze history for the missed-items question. Scored by `python -m evals.voice`.
